fact: The July 2024 health statistics yearbook (37th edition, year 2023) is built from facility monthly activity reports and registers, now on DHIS2, and the ministry states it publishes the yearbook every year.
title: Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2023, Tome A, 37ème édition
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique, Direction des Statistiques et de l'Information Sanitaire
